description: Focused LLM review auto-fix PRD for the blocking Go CI failure on PR #50. Scope is limited to repairing the failed govulncheck gate by updating the vulnerable dependency and proving the same CI-equivalent gates locally.

userStories.title: Govulncheck uses fixed x/net release
userStories.description: As a maintainer of Weave's CLI and SDK HTTP paths, I want the Go dependency graph to use a golang.org/x/net release that fixes GO-2026-5026 so the CI govulncheck gate passes without weakening the security scan.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the GitHub Go CI job failed in govulncheck for GO-2026-5026, when the dependency graph is inspected, then golang.org/x/net is pinned at or above v0.55.0, the fixed release reported by the CI log.
Given the CI workflow continues to run make vulncheck, when the local BDD guard for CI security gates runs, then it fails on vulnerable x/net versions and passes with the fixed version.

Given the local repository runs the PR Go CI-equivalent checks, when build, vet, golangci-lint, race+coverage, covercheck, contract tests, and govulncheck are executed, then each gate passes without suppressing govulncheck findings.
The fix changes only the focused dependency/test/Ralph state needed for the review blocking finding.
dependencies: LLM review auto-fix context in scripts/ralph/progress.txt reported PR #50 Go CI blocked on a failing govulncheck step.
GitHub run 26298559112 and latest PR check run 26300065159 both report GO-2026-5026 in golang.org/x/net@v0.54.0, fixed in v0.55.0.
Existing CI BDD tests in scripts/ci/ci_workflow_bdd_test.go verify the govulncheck workflow contract.
